study: Fresh fixed-policy SQL candidates for an observed-input-compatible reference migration

population.inclusion: Exact string question/evidence and database ID agreement in pinned archived MiniDev and HF Arcwise-Plat sql_only. Null and empty evidence are distinct. No reference-SQL condition in selection.

generation.tokenization: Native pinned chat template with add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False, preserve_thinking=False; exact input IDs passed to stream_generate
generation.truncation: None; over-context cases are recorded errors and remain in denominator
generation.database_access: Read-only table DDL during preparation only; no row values; no candidate execution by inference driver

smoke.purpose: Loading, exact token accounting and output format/termination only; no scoring or reward inspection
smoke.full_run: Regenerate both as part of the full unchanged357-case run; smoke results never substitute full results
smoke.amendment_rule: Any loader bug must be fixed and recorded before full run. No prompt tuning from correctness or reward.

outputs.network: Audit hook blocks sockets; model loading offline
outputs.reward_blind: This driver never reads either reference SQL during inference and never scores output. The preparation stage reads source JSON but selects only public fields for prompts.

limitations: One greedy candidate per task; not an estimate across sampling seeds.
No inference tool access, repair loop or database value samples.
4-bit local quantized model; not the full-precision or hosted model.
Evaluation-only reference migration: no training and no new-policy performance claim.
